name: Jie Liu
evidence: Could not identify the source paper, so no anchor exists. Searched arXiv API (title and all-field queries for cross-cultural / cultural commonsense sentiment work) - no hit; alphaXiv discover_papers for 'Evaluation and Optimization of Large Language Models for Cross-Cultural Sentiment Analysis' returned only unrelated cultural-alignment papers; Semantic Scholar, Crossref and Europe PMC APIs were unreachable from this environment. WebSearch on the exact quoted title returned no matching record (only unrelated cross-lingual sentiment work: Model Arena, PeerJ adaptive self-alignment, Scientific Reports multimodal ensemble); WebSearch combining the topic with "Jie Liu" and "Yuting He" also returned no paper containing those authors. With no verified paper, no affiliation, lab or co-author anchor is available, and 'Jie Liu' has an extremely high namesake count, so every candidate profile would be an unanchored name match. Reported not_found per the namesake rule rather than risking a wrong person. | RESOLVED THIS ROUND (source paper identified; person still unresolvable). The paper was NOT missing - its identifier was in the repo's own seed all along (research/seed/cdeval_pool.json): DOI 10.1109/AIETA69357.2026.11508902, '2026 International Conference on AI in Education Technology and Applications (AIETA)', 2026, exactly two authors (Jie Liu, Yuting He). Confirmed via the S2 paper endpoint, which also returns the abstract (cross-cultural sentiment analysis benchmarking Qwen-plus, GPT-5.2 and GLM-4-plus over 100 English abstracts - so almost certainly a China-based group). S2 returns NO affiliations, openAccessPdf is empty, the paper is not indexed by web search, and ieeexplore.ieee.org / doi.org are blocked by this environment's network policy, so the affiliation block is unreachable from here. Additionally, the S2 author entity itself is unusable: authorId 2285060791 carries DBLP aliases ['Jie Liu 0001', 'Jie Liu 0047'] - two distinct DBLP persons merged into one record - and its 19 papers span unrelated fields (long-video agents, neuro-symbolic reasoning, MOSS-VL, BERT for adverse drug events, Chinese preference alignment, query routing, visual generation). So the entity is an aggregate of several people and cannot anchor a contact lookup even in principle. BLOCKER IS ENVIRONMENTAL, NOT EVIDENTIAL: fetching the IEEE Xplore page for DOI 10.1109/AIETA69357.2026.11508902 from a network that permits ieeexplore.ieee.org would very likely print both authors' affiliations and resolve this row.
